mandatoryCriteria: All permitted active column cards can be loaded beyond the first15 with explicit server-cursor controls. Preserve canonical position/id order, current title/priority/assignee/due query and each source board in merged view; report loaded, matching and total counts distinctly, including done-column local collapse.

Filters perform actual server reads for title, priority, one current-contract assignee and due semantics; query keys bind filters and snapshot/page identity. A column filter selects exact authorized column data/pages and counts, not a global or cross-project query. No cached-first-page-only false no-match or total claim.

Changing filters, snapshot version, structure or access invalidates prior cursor pages without discarding card/comment/create drafts. Stale cursor and read/move failures explain recovery; server counts are never inferred from loaded array length. Foreground polling/refetch must not silently merge pages from different snapshots.

Pointer drag stays disabled while filters make relative placement ambiguous. Drag and visible click/keyboard Move use actual canonical placement response and current expected versions, not first-page last-neighbor guesses. Move offers first,last,before,after and a bounded/paginated unfiltered reference-card list; stale placement conflicts do not auto-overwrite teammates or discard drafts.

Owner/Manager can archive/reopen a permitted board through confirmation and current backend behavior; project archive blocks board lifecycle, settings and card writes. Member/Viewer lack lifecycle controls. Archived boards remain discoverable for reopening without implying deleted cards or paused trash clocks.

People role controls match server target rules: only Owner appoints/removes Managers; Manager cannot change self,peer Manager or Owner and can change/remove only Member/Viewer. Board name/description remain Owner-only. Show protected role context and actual refusals; do not treat UI hiding as server authorization.

Full People directory/emails and its navigation are Owner/ProjectManager only. Member/Viewer direct-page visits show honest permission state without fetching or rendering old cached directory entries/emails. Keep existing permitted board-scoped assignee/mention pickers and their constrained response scopes.
Add plain-language COLUMN_HAS_RETAINED_REFERENCES refusal with no fake remedy or hidden counts. It is an interim integrity guard and cannot close genuine empty-column removal BRD-06.

Meaningful API-boundary/state/role regressions cover exact cursor/filter/placement parameters, over-page source merges and stale reset behavior, plus original request identity retained by prior comment/quick-add slice. Run web suite,typecheck,production build with raw logs and preserve failed rounds.

No source/fixture/unit/browser diagnostic alone approves phases. Root real Chrome+localAPI+PostgreSQL integration and fresh independent final-target review remain required; UAT checks follow local gates and deployment.

explicitContractLimits: Snapshot accepts one assigneeId; expose single selection rather than pretending multi-select OR is supported.
due=upcoming means aftertoday, not a7day interval. Use exact labels and server semantics; do not silently alter contracts.
Snapshot has no columnId parameter; per-column pages use cards endpoint columnId and selecting visible snapshot columns uses their canonical server counts.

Placement returns small neighbor result, but its current database scan is unbounded. Parent was notified; backend bounded-query verification is separate and required before claiming that end-to-end criterion.
scopeLimits: Own apps/web source/tests and this role-owned review evidence. No backend,sharedcontracts,rootpackage,governance,dependency installation or deployment edits. Invitation delivery/pagination, imports/results,otherfeeds/settings/crossnavigation are later slices. Preserve previous comment/quickadd retry state. Root owns scripts/e2e and its .next-e2e diagnostics; use .next-build for build checks without reverting unrelated generated dev paths.
